cvEn:
Shabtai Shvarberger, son of Tzvia and Eliyahu, was born in 5688 (1928) in Poland. He immigrated to the country in 1947. He was a member of Kibbutz Tel Yosef and trained in painting at Ein Harod.

He was drafted into the IDF, but died in a military hospital on 12 Av 5710 (31 July 1950) and was laid to rest in the military cemetery at Nahalat Yitzhak.
